senses.gloss: m. (part. pass. of גָּרַד or גָּרֵר) stripped, bare.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 598:1">Yalk. Ruth 598</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01273"><he>גַּרְדּוּם</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>גְּרוּדִים</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33a:7">Ab. Zar. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>גרוד׳</he> wine jars not lined with pitch; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <he>גְּרוּדִין</he>.—Fem. pl. <he>גְּרוּדוֹת</he>. Y. ib. II, 41ᵇ bot.
